exposure: Pre-pregnancy body mass index (PPBMI) categories (underweight, normal-weight, overweight, obese)
cohort: The study included data from 2,909 pregnant women diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM).
finding: Pre-pregnancy BMI significantly impacts pregnancy and neonatal outcomes in women with GDM, with both underweight and overweight/obese categories associated with adverse outcomes.
mod_finding: Underweight women with GDM showed a lower risk of cesarean sections, while overweight and obese women experienced a higher risk of cesarean sections.
